items.claim: tile `size` that is fractional gets a truncated raster tile with seams, and drifts from the SVG export
`patchBounds` samples an 8×8 grid, so it under-bounds a bowed edge and the bake crops the bulge
`textCommand`, `textCommandFromRuns` and `textCommandFromRunsInto` pass tile and image paints through unresolved, so that text draws nothing
a text layer's cached box never sees a face land or a text engine register, so it is culled or clipped on stale bounds
`registerPaintDrawKind` that throws on a program with no source leaves the programs registered before it in place
a `'bounds'` linear gradient on a non-square box tilts its bands differently from SVG's `objectBoundingBox`
items.note: `paintToLocalUnits` and `paintToBoundsUnits` now move a diagonal gradient's `to`, so gradient handles show and commit the point the bands actually use. Because of that I updated the expected values in three existing tests: `commandPaint.test.ts`, `SceneGradientHandles.test.tsx` and `fromKit.trim.test.ts`.

items.claim: `retainBudget`'s stated overshoot of 36 MiB at 4x leaves out the single-sampled scratch buffer
`keepKey` keeps effect uniform arrays by reference, so a write in place to one still matches the stale surface
a `chunks` tile has no bound on its scatter count, so a tiny `chunkSize` or a huge `density` hangs the resolve
items.note: This needed a behavior call: the scatter is now capped at one chunk per pixel of the tile. I recorded it in `docs/unruled.md` under a new section, "Audit round fifty-four (2026-11-20): renderer, part two".
